_comment: ImageName -> what the picture is built from, for /create-image-refs (Mode A, Item variant). subject names the shipped ImageName used as the SUBJECT reference (the same object, changed only as asked); style lists shipped ImageNames used as STYLE references only. subject_words describes the subject reference in the prompt; change is the one thing only this picture shows; item is the subject sentence for the /create-image step 3 template; avoid is appended to that template's Avoid list. finish is keyed or full-bleed (measured on the subject reference with process_card_art.py --check). No character or scene fragments: every ACT reference is shipped art the owner approved by shipping it.
